task: Prospective whole-pipeline spatial validation, fixed model and fixed source-pinned methods
selection_rule: Lexicographically first unscored native 256 s1 case; lexicographically first native 512 s5 case with deterministic centre [128:384]^3 crop. Selection uses original ZIP names, never CT, manual topology or performance. All three s5 native 256 cases are already revealed.
case_role: new spatial postprocessor/comparator parameter-heldout; pretrained-model membership retained as separate provenance

frame.reference_rule: All original NML nodes, edges, IDs and branches retained; local XYZ and inside flags rebased to declared crop. Existing evaluator clips edge intersections with that ROI.

geometries.old_baseline_clean: Original mature spline/catalog/gap MLP, then native 45-degree/100-voxel/16-voxel cleanup
geometries.old_dp_clean: Same original raw input plus immutable 1afa30ab DP then same native cleanup
geometries.current_raw: Current bee798f7 author defaults on shared fixed input; threads capped at 2
geometries.current_clean: Same current raw plus the identical native cleanup

matching_rule: Unchanged public match_coverage.py: r2 longest-first whole-curve lower/upper brackets and coverage residuals, identical prefixes at r3

gates.primary: Both new cases, both r2 brackets: continuity relative gain >0 and observed interior/boundary switches held or reduced at both r2/r3
gates.companion: Same independent gate against current equally native-cleaned output
gates.DP_specific: Same independent gate against legacy native-clean baseline; separate from architecture controls
gates.native: Unchanged assigned-family validator on every adjacent segment of all four legacy clean outputs; all original gaps, IDs, order and annotations preserved

complete_output: 40 matched rows, 16 unique full rows, raw/current and clean operating contracts; unknown/ambiguous/support/coverage residuals/r3 negative results all retained
reference_open_order: Actual immutable public freeze receipt before new NML intake; reference performance opens only after fixed CT/P and every geometry is terminal
stop_rule: Any failed gate limits the corresponding recommendation to its measured scope. No post-result parameter/model/crop search. Runtime/data failure stops this execution at its actual failure; fixed-source repair only for concrete invocation faults.

shared_input.CT: uint8 256^3 ZYX cube, original fixed upstream normalization/inference
shared_input.legacy: Exactly original fixed t60/b40 native mature-pipeline adapter
